main_text.l: Atque alij, mores qui monstrauêre pudicos,
Inter quos merito liceat memorare Catonem,
Qui veteris Sophiæ dogmata pura notat.
Vt sacros Christi vates veteréfque Prophetas
Nunc taceam, ad Superos qui docuêre viam.
Siccine Mortales! meritis sic gratia tantis
O genus infelix,ô duro marmore dura
Corda magis,bonitas quæ haud movet ista Dei.

page.notes: The verse is printed in italic with long s rendered as f-like forms in the scan; transcribed as plain s. Line-final hyphens "pu-dicos", "Ca-tonem", "Pro-phetas", "do-cuêre", "mo-uet" are line-end breaks and kept as printed. Some words are partly obscured by show-through from the reverse page (e.g. "meritis", "temnitis", "marmore"); readings are as far as legible. The line "Corda magis,bonitas quæ haud movet ista Dei." is printed "quæ haud" with the line ending "mo-uet ista Dei"; the scan reads "quae haud mo-uet ista Dei" and is copied as printed.
